summary: Bed Bath & Beyond Inc. (BBBY) filed an 8-K on June 16, 2026, announcing a definitive merger agreement to acquire Fathom Holdings Inc. (FTHM). Under the terms, each FTHM share will be exchanged for 0.2236 BBBY shares (stock consideration), with FTHM surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. No exact price/share, total value, or premium is explicitly stated in the excerpt; the exchange ratio is subject to adjustment per Section 2.10 of the agreement, with a sample calculation in Exhibit A. Outstanding FTHM options will be canceled for no consideration, while restricted stock awards will be assumed and converted into BBBY restricted stock on similar vesting terms. The board's recommendation, advisor names, and expected close date are not mentioned in this excerpt. What to watch: regulatory approvals and shareholder votes; risk-arb focuses on BBBY stock price relative to the exchange ratio mechanics.
